core_capabilities: Read and send channel messages containing attachments and user mentions.
Start and continue private direct-message conversations and browse or search an all-DMs view.
Start and reply in message threads, react to messages, and use a consolidated Threads view to review and continue channel or DM discussions, optionally broadcasting a reply back to its channel.
Create public or private channels, add or remove channel members, edit channel descriptions, and star or unstar channels.
secondary_capabilities: Discover messages, channels, and people through search and directories and initiate a direct message from a person result.
Review messages that mention the current user and reactions to their messages.
Curate channel history by editing or deleting messages and pinning important messages.
Update and save the current user's name, display name, title, status message, email, and time zone.
Invite a teammate by email and create a pending workspace invitation.
